editorial:
Imagine heading out for a relaxing hunting trip in the Florida Everglades with your best buddies and family, only to realize you are the ones being hunted. You get a group of people who think they are the top predators in the swamp, but they quickly find out there is something much meaner lurking in the brush. The vibe is super tense from the start, mixing a survival trip with a scary mystery. You will spend most of the movie trying to figure out if the threat is a scary ghost from a Native American legend or something even worse that followed one of the soldiers home from the Middle East.

The action is punchy and the scares hit well, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. The acting is solid enough to make you care who lives and dies, and the twisty plot keeps you guessing until the end. If you love creature features and swampy settings, you should definitely check this out. It looks great if you can find it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to watch. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the group realizes the evil spirit has been using them to feed. The big twist reveals that the demon is a war entity that possesses people to cause chaos. In the final fight, the survivors have to fight off the possessed member of their party. While some of the group manages to escape the swamp, the movie leaves you feeling that the curse is not fully gone and could return.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and monster movies.
